name: genesis-agentic-os
description: Genesis is an agentic operating system that provisions and runs businesses with AI agents and full-duplex voice.

tools.name: provision_business
tools.description: Generate a provisionable business skeleton (build manifest, file tree, infra plan, launch checklist) from a founder's intent.

tools.name: generate_content
tools.description: Generate marketing/landing content for a business using the content agent.

tools.name: create_landing_page
tools.description: Generate landing page structure and copy for a business.

tools.name: analyze_seo
tools.description: Run technical SEO analysis and produce JSON-LD, meta, and sitemap recommendations.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a follow-up ticket for a lead routed to a department.

tools.name: start_voice_session
tools.description: Begin a full-duplex voice conversation with the Genesis launch assistant.

tools.name: create_outreach_campaign
tools.description: Draft an outreach campaign for human review and approval.
